description: This file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class implementing OAuth2 refresh token management, including creating, persisting, revoking, and checking refresh tokens within an OAuth2 server context.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements the OAuth2 refresh token repository interface to manage refresh tokens, including creation, persistence, revocation, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a BeanManager instance.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RefreshTokenEntity instance.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token to storage, associating it with an access token and expiry time.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Revokes (deletes) a refresh token identified by tokenId.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given refresh token has been revoked or is expired.
